issues.description: Field 'Animal.name' type mismatch: the problem statement UML declares the attribute as 'name: String' (problem_statement.md line 27), whereas the reference solution implements a concrete backing field of type 'StringBuilder' (solution_repository/src/de/tum/cit/ase/Animal.java line 4). Although the solution's public getter and setter use String in their signatures, the different concrete field type diverges from the UML and can confuse students expecting a plain String field.
issues.suggestedFix: Align the implementation with the UML by changing the field to a plain String (e.g. 'private String name;') and update the constructor/getter/setter to work with String, or alternatively update the problem statement/UML to explicitly specify 'StringBuilder' if that was intentional. Prefer using 'String' here to match the UML and the public API students expect.
